note:
The ESMO/SIOG Cancer in the Elderly Working Group position paper, 2024. **Loaded as a joint position paper, not as a new edition of Wildiers 2014 or Decoster 2015** -- neither the paper nor SIOG's own guidance pages say it supersedes them, and recording a supersession nobody declared would be our invention. What it adds is roughly a decade of trial evidence on geriatric assessment and management.

Nothing in it is about a disease stage, so the rule file is exclusions and a default.

default.note: Geriatric assessment and management, tools, timing, and who to assess. True at every stage of every cancer, which is what `general_principle` states -- the same shape the 2014 and 2015 SIOG papers already carry at 114 of 114 and 81 of 81 passages.
